Privacy Policy

Bade Daily List — Daily Product List Creator

← Back to Bade Daily List

Bade Daily List · WIPLabs · Last updated: March 2025

🔒 Bade Daily List does not collect, store, or share any personal data from users or devices.

1. About Bade Daily List

Bade Daily List is a simple productivity app that allows you to add products once and generate a fresh daily list to share — via email, messaging apps, or any other method you prefer. All data is created and managed entirely on your device.

2. Information We Do Not Collect

Our app does not collect, store, or share any personal data. We do not track users, request personal information, or share data with third parties. This includes:

  • Personal identification information
  • Device identifiers or hardware information
  • Location data
  • Usage analytics or behavioral data
  • Contacts, camera, or any other device permissions

3. How the App Works

  • The app allows you to create product lists and generate shareable daily lists.
  • All data remains on your device and is not transmitted to external servers.
  • You may share your lists manually through your preferred sharing methods.
  • If you delete the app, all data is permanently removed from your device.

4. Third-Party Services

Bade Daily List does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services.

5. Data Security

Since we do not collect or transmit any data, there are no security risks related to data storage or processing on our end. Your data stays entirely on your device.

6. Children's Privacy

Bade Daily List is rated 4+ and is suitable for all ages. Since we do not collect any personal data from any users, there are no special privacy concerns related to younger users.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: hello@wiplabs.app
